  - https://singjupost.com/transcript-cmg-interview-with-tesla-ceo-elon-musk/

  - https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-09-25/Full-Exclusive-CMG-interview-with-Tesla-CEO-Elon-Musk-1QJCMoucyVG/p.html

- **Space / reusability / multiplanetary:** Closest US–China space cooperation priority = coordinating satellite orbits to avoid collisions. “Full and rapid reusability” as the fundamental launch breakthrough; hoping to catch Starship “around the end of next month” and re-fly later this year or early next year. Multiplanetary / self-growing cities on Moon & Mars as lifespan-of-consciousness argument.
  - https://www.leonarddavid.com/elon-musk-on-u-s-china-space-cooperation/ (Leonard David, September 27th, 2026)
  - Transcript: https://singjupost.com/transcript-cmg-interview-with-tesla-ceo-elon-musk/

articles.excerpt: Outcome: Liftoff Mon Sep 28, 8:49 a.m. EDT (7:49 a.m. CDT / 12:49 UTC) from Starbase Pad 2. First Starship flight to reach low Earth orbit after 13 suborbital flights. Ascent drama: One of Ship’s six Raptors shut down early on ascent; five…
articles.body:
**Outcome:** Liftoff **Mon Sep 28, 8:49 a.m. EDT** (7:49 a.m. CDT / 12:49 UTC) from Starbase Pad 2. First Starship flight to reach **low Earth orbit** after 13 suborbital flights. Ship ~**171–180 mi** altitude; Super Heavy controlled splashdown in Gulf of Mexico off Starbase (booster catch / ship catch **not** attempted — ocean returns by plan).

**Ascent drama:** One of Ship’s six Raptors shut down early on ascent; five others burned longer. After a multi-minute coast hold (webcast briefly suggested aborting insertion), flight controllers cleared the three center / sea-level Raptors and executed the **first-ever orbital insertion burn** (~19 s, ~+204 mph) on a healthy center engine. Super Heavy also saw apparent early engine outs (ascent + boost-back); still completed controlled Gulf splashdown.

**Payload:** Deployed **26 Starlink V3** satellites (first operational orbital V3 batch; too large for Falcon 9 fairing; ~2 t each; ~**1 Tbps** capacity each vs prior gen — SpaceX claim). Pez-style deployer; SpaceX reported **contact with all 26**. Initial low-inclination orbit (~±30°) for range-safety overflight limits.

**Early end:** Planned ~**10 h / ~6 orbits**, Chile Pacific splashdown. Instead, “out of an abundance of caution” after the ascent engine issue, de-orbit to backup zone **north of Hawaii**; splashdown **11:57 a.m. EDT** (~3 h after liftoff). Ship tipped / broke up in fireball (expected for water landing). FAA: **no formal mishap investigation** — events within licensed/authorized activities.

**Next:** Catch / RTLS still ahead (Musk earlier: even-or-better odds on catch → re-fly by YE or early next year). FAA ATC high-profile list points to possible next Starbase flight in **October**; KSC pad activation aiming for Florida Starship late this year / early next. Raptor 3 still iterating (engine issues on all three Raptor-3 flights to date — May, July abort, F14).

articles.body:
**SpaceX / SpaceXAI**
- **Musk says SpaceXAI will become "SpaceXSI."** Early Sunday Musk posted "No more AI," then "SI" and "It's better." Asked whether SpaceXAI would be renamed SpaceXSI, he replied "Yes, we will make that change." He gave no timeline and didn't say whether it's a legal or branding change. As of Reuters' story the @SpaceXAI account was unchanged, and the company didn't respond to a request for comment. The move follows Trump's push for "super intelligence" over "AI." [Reuters via Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-10-04-musk-says-he-will-rename-spacexai-to-spacexsi/) · [Teslarati](https://www.teslarati.com/elon-musk-follows-trumps-lead-says-a-spacex-name-change-is-coming/)
- **Next launch: SDA T1TL-A, early Monday.** A Falcon 9 is set to carry 21 Northrop Grumman Tranche 1 Transport Layer satellites for the Space Development Agency from Vandenberg SLC-4E at 4:17 a.m. ET Mon Oct 5, with a backup on Oct 6. This is the 4th of 9 Tranche 1 missions SpaceX will fly for the SDA. Booster B1103 is on its 6th flight and targets Landing Zone 4. No SpaceX launch flew on Oct 4. [SpaceX](https://www.spacex.com/launches/sda-t1tl-a) · [Spaceflight Now](https://spaceflightnow.com/2026/10/04/live-coverage-spacex-to-launch-21-data-transport-satellites-for-the-space-development-agency/)
- **Starlink 15-25 slips to Oct 10.** Spaceflight Now's schedule (updated Oct 4) now lists the 27-satellite V2 Mini launch from Vandenberg for Oct 10 at 7 p.m. ET, delayed from Sept 30. [Spaceflight Now](https://spaceflightnow.com/launch-schedule/)
- **Starship:** Nothing new on Oct 4. Flight 14 (Sept 28) is still the latest. Flight 15 has no official date; some trackers list it provisionally around Oct 19, but that's unconfirmed. [Teslarati](https://www.teslarati.com/spacex-starship-flight-14-launch/)

**Starlink**
- **Iran summons Norway's ambassador over Starlink.** On Sunday Tehran handed Ambassador Paul Bjørnstad a formal protest. It says Norway, which registers Starlink with the ITU, hasn't stopped unauthorized Starlink transmissions inside Iran. [Iran International](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202610049557)
- **Communities beta (from earlier this week, recapped Oct 4).** A new program lets a host share one dish and sell hourly, daily, weekly or monthly access passes, with Starlink handling billing. This is a weekly-recap item, not Oct 4 news. [KeepTrack (citing Teslarati)](https://keeptrack.space/x-report/spacex-brief-2026-10-04)
- V3 deployment and Star Mind: nothing new.

**Tesla**
- **Emergency Drive Away rolling out.** An OTA update lets a car shift into Drive and pull away from a U.S. Supercharger while still plugged in, for emergencies only. The connector breaks away, and Tesla warns this damages both the car and the charger. It needs software 2026.38.3 and excludes pre-2021 Model S/X. Tesla added it after a fatal shooting at an Idaho Supercharger this summer. Tesla Charging announced it earlier in the week; The Drive wrote it up Oct 4. [The Drive](https://www.thedrive.com/news/tesla-adds-emergency-feature-so-you-can-drive-away-from-supercharger-without-unplugging)
- **Robotaxi follow-up: Musk answers CNBC's "rocky" first month.** CNBC called the Cybercab's first month "rocky." Musk replied, "We are being extremely careful with autonomous safety…" (X post dated Oct 3; exact time not confirmed). Not a Tesla App says Tesla still targets 24/7 Robotaxi service as early as this month, tied to FSD v15 on Robotaxi vehicles. That's a target, not a confirmed date. Fleet count (169) and 11 p.m. hours were already covered. [Not a Tesla App](https://www.notateslaapp.com/news/4768/tesla-extends-robotaxi-hours-in-austin-adds-111-cybercabs) · [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/03/tesla-cybercab-pressure-to-expand-after-rocky-first-month-in-austin.html) · [TeslaNorth](https://teslanorth.com/2026/10/04/elon-musk-touts-careful-cybercab-rollout-austin-fleet-169/)
- **Roadster:** Demo still set for Oct 15; no new update. **Optimus:** Nothing new (the AI5/AI6 memory cut was covered Oct 1). **Q3 deliveries:** No new follow-ups beyond the Oct 2 coverage (486,532).

articles.body:
**Ravens: beat Titans 24–18 (now 3-1)**
- **Final: BAL 24, TEN 18 at M&T Bank Stadium, in rain.** Baltimore led 24-7 at halftime, then didn't score in the second half. Tennessee got within 6 on Cam Ward's 3-yard TD to Wan'Dale Robinson plus a 2-point conversion with 1:12 left. Malaki Starks caught the onside kick to end it. The win snapped a four-game home losing streak. The Ravens play at Atlanta next Sunday night. [CBS Sports/AP](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/gametracker/recap/NFL_20261004_TEN@BAL/) · [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/game-recap-ravens-titans-week-4-game-recap-injuries-lamar-jackson)
- **Key performers:**
  - Lamar Jackson: 15/20, 222 yards, 2 TDs before leaving.
  - Zay Flowers: 8 catches, 118 yards, 1 TD (19-yard TD, plus catches of 52 and 23).
  - Mark Andrews: 3-yard TD that capped a 98-yard drive.
  - Derrick Henry: 23 carries, 73 yards, 1 TD against his old team. He's the first player since 2015 with 7 rushing TDs in the first four games.
  - Tyler Loop: 64-yard FG at the end of the half, a career long, the longest ever at M&T and 2nd-longest in franchise history.
  - Defense: Trenton Simpson had his first career INT; Kyle Hamilton forced a fumble; Nnamdi Madubuike stuffed a 4th-and-goal at the 2; rookie Ethan Burke got his first sack.
  - Tyler Huntley: 8/9 for 63 yards in relief.
  - Ravens penalties: 13 for 131 yards. [CBS Sports box](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/gametracker/recap/NFL_20261004_TEN@BAL/) · [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/game-recap-ravens-titans-week-4-game-recap-injuries-lamar-jackson)
- **Lamar ankle injury.** Lamar hurt his ankle on a sack (Jermaine Johnson) on the last offensive snap of the first half and didn't return. Minter said postgame there was "some talk" of bringing him back, that it was "a little bit of an ankle," and that "we don't know enough." PFT (7:24 p.m. ET) reports he left in a walking boot and is believed to be week-to-week, pending an MRI. Other outlets said day-to-day, so his status is unconfirmed. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-ankle-injury-ravens-titans-tyler-huntley) · [NBC Sports/PFT](https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/lamar-jackson-is-believed-to-week-to-week-pending-an-mri)
- **More injuries.** CB Marlon Humphrey (calf), TE Durham Smythe (Achilles) and RG Andrew Vorhees (foot) all left and didn't return; Minter had no updates. Trey Hendrickson was out. LT Ronnie Stanley (toe) returned after missing Week 3. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-injuries-durham-smythe-marlon-humphrey-andrew-vorhees-achilles-calf-sidelined)

The game had 28 combined penalties for 247 yards, the most in an FBS game since 2021. **SpaceX / SpaceXAI**
- **SpaceXSI rename: not done yet.** On Monday the rename was still only Musk's Sunday promise ("Yes, we will make that change"), and he gave no timeline. Euronews (6:42 a.m. ET) said the company's websites and social accounts hadn't changed. The official x.ai/news page still showed "SpaceXAI" Monday evening and had no post about the rename. Coverage Monday (Euronews, Quartz, Indian Express) was follow-up on Sunday's posts. Euronews adds that Trump announced a "Super Intelligence Force" on Sunday. [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/05/musk-to-follow-trump-and-rebrand-spacexai-as-spacexsi) · [Quartz](https://qz.com/spacex-spacexsi-ai-super-intelligence-musk-trump-100526) · [x.ai/news](https://x.ai/news)
- **SDA T1TL-A scrubbed at the last second; no launch, no landing.** Falcon 9 had an automatic abort in the final minute, just before T-0, around 4:28 a.m. ET. articles.body:
- **Cohere North 2 (Mon Oct 5).** This is an overhaul of Cohere's enterprise agent platform. It adds rebuilt multistep orchestration with human sign-off, memory across sessions, a skills feature, shareable prompt-built agents and a drag-and-drop workflow builder. New connectors include Slack, GitHub and SharePoint/OneDrive. Admins can set per-user and per-agent token spending caps, and agents get autonomy policies. It's model-agnostic and can run on-prem or air-gapped. [SiliconANGLE](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/05/cohere-unveils-north-2-ai-agent-platform-with-rebuilt-orchestration-and-token-spending-caps/)
- **Reflection AI Beam (Mon Oct 5), a model release that's relevant to agents.** Beam is Nvidia-backed Reflection's first open-weight model: 501B-parameter MoE with 23B active and a 1M-token context, aimed at reasoning, coding and agentic tasks. Reflection claims parity with GLM-5.2 at 3–4x less inference compute; that's unverified. Weights come later this month. Side note: Reflection has compute deals with SpaceX and Nebius. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/05/reflection-debuts-beam-a-open-weight-ai-model-to-rival-chinese-models-at-lower-compute-cost/)

Live bookmarks as **@xristafer** (box Chrome; X API unused):
- **Bot fleet best practices:** @benln's tip is to have your main Grok Bot read the new x.ai/bot/guides and then recommend best practices for the rest of your bots. That's directly on-theme for the Grok Bot team.
- **Skills for AI media:** @claudeskills101 shares 8 prompts for making explainer videos with Claude Opus 5.5 inside Claude Code, from kinetic text up to Manim math animations.
- **AI influencer playbook:** @EXM7777 says building an AI influencer now is like buying Bitcoin in 2017 and lays out a Higgsfield workflow.
- **List check:** @theo is still bookmarked. @0xCarnagee's Grok Bot pair and @godofprompt didn't show between @theo and @alex_prompter. They may have been removed, or X may have skipped them while lazy-loading. Unconfirmed.
- **Real launches Tue — Claude for Google Workspace** is in public beta. It's a sidebar in Docs/Sheets/Slides that edits in place, asks before each edit, and carries over your connectors and skills. Admins can deploy it from the Google Admin console. [Claude](https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-now-works-in-google-docs-sheets-and-slides)
- **OpenAI + Ironclad** trained computer-use agents on 11 legal/procurement contracting tasks, like NDA setup, approval routing and jurisdiction-aware clauses. GPT-6 Astra scored 55% vs 41.6% for GPT-5.6 Sol, and time per attempt about halved. That's the closest yet to law-firm ops. [OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/advancing-computer-use-with-ironclad/)
- **OpenAI Decisions API** is in public beta. It returns typed predicate/choice/score answers on gpt-6-luna, and OpenAI says it's about 10x faster than Responses. It's built for routing and picking an agent's next step; input costs \$0.10/1M and output is free. [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/openai-releases-decisions-api-in-public-beta-powered-by-gpt-6-luna/)
- **Anthropic's Cyber Verification Program** now has Defense, Red Team and Specialized tiers, with fewer cyber blocks for SOC, incident response and malware work. Corporate security teams qualify, so it may matter for KPD IT. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/cyber-verification-program)
- **Smaller:** Claude Code 2.1.292 adds marketplace plugin installs and an effort setting for sub-agents, and fixes scheduled tasks not firing after `/resume`. The Grok Bot changelog is still at v0.66.0 (Oct 2).
Theme of the day: agents moving into everyday business software like Docs, contracting tools and the bot fleet itself.

articles.body:
- **Claude for Google Workspace (public beta, Tue).** It's a sidebar add-on for Docs, Sheets and Slides on all paid Claude plans. It reads the open file and your selection and edits in place. Sheets work includes formulas, pivots, charts and Python round-trips; Slides work uses the deck's own layouts. The default mode is "Ask before edits," with per-change approval cards. It carries over your Claude connectors and skills. Enterprise controls (Compliance API, CMEK, OpenTelemetry audit) apply. Admins can deploy it from the Google Admin console. Separate Docs/Sheets/Slides connectors let Claude create and edit Google files from chat, and on Team/Enterprise plans an owner has to enable them first. [Claude](https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-now-works-in-google-docs-sheets-and-slides) · [9to5Google](https://9to5google.com/2026/10/06/claude-google-docs-sheet-slides/)
- **OpenAI + Ironclad: computer-use agents trained on contracting workflows (Tue).** This is OpenAI's first partner for training agents on specialized business software. Ironclad helped define 11 legal, commercial and procurement tasks, such as NDA setup, approval routing and jurisdiction-aware clauses, plus hosted practice environments. On that research eval GPT-6 Astra scored 55.0% vs 41.6% for GPT-5.6 Sol, and estimated time per attempt fell from 37.0 to 19.2 minutes. An internal model hit 63.7%. OpenAI is inviting other software vendors to contribute tasks. Relevant to legal ops at a firm. [OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/advancing-computer-use-with-ironclad/) · [ZeroHour summary](https://zerohour.day/item/9964af802e9c5fdee2b956b6ca12adb5b9c62816)
- **OpenAI Decisions API is now public beta (Tue; it was a DevDay preview).** `POST /v1/decisions` on gpt-6-luna returns typed answers to the questions you define. There are three answer types: predicate (a 0–1 probability), choice (with per-option probabilities) and score. OpenAI says it's about 10x faster than the Responses API, which suits routing, classification or picking an agent's next action. Pricing is $0.10 per 1M input tokens, and output is free. It supports ZDR and HIPAA, with US and EU residency. GA is expected "in the coming weeks." [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/openai-releases-decisions-api-in-public-beta-powered-by-gpt-6-luna/)
- **Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program (Tue).** There are three tiers (Defense, Red Team, Specialized) with reduced cyber blocks on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Mythos 5.1. Defense Access covers SOC (security operations), incident response and malware work. Anthropic says it answers those applications within days, and corporate security teams qualify. Data retention is required until "Enterprise Frontier Safeguards" ships later this fall. Possibly relevant to KPD IT security. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/cyber-verification-program)
- **Claude Code 2.1.291 / 2.1.292 (Oct 6).** 2.1.291 fixes two regressions, including dropped permission-prompt answers in cloud sessions. 2.1.292 adds `claude plugin install --marketplace`, an `effort` parameter for sub-agents, and a configurable 529-overload retry delay. It also fixes durable scheduled tasks not firing after `/resume` and a Windows `rm -rf` 8.3-short-name home-folder hole. (2.1.290 on Oct 5 changed defaults: project settings can no longer turn on Claude in Chrome.) [Core-Directive changelog](https://changelogs.core-directive.com/v/2.1.292) · [Claude Hub](https://www.claudehub.fr/en/blog/claude-code-2-1-290-291-chrome-pyright-permissions/)
- **Smaller, Oct 6:** Anthropic's Claude for Startups now gives eligible startups a free year of Claude Team (up to 5 seats) and $1,000 in API credits. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/06/anthropic-gives-startups-a-free-year-of-enterprise-service-and-1000-in-token-credits/) Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open on-device multimodal embedding model for RAG. [Google](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/embeddinggemma-2/)

- **FCC approved 15,000 next-gen Starlink Mobile (direct-to-device) satellites.** The grant was Tue Oct 6 and was reported Wed.
  - SpaceX can use the EchoStar spectrum it's acquiring (testing only until that deal closes, scheduled 11/30/2027) and T-Mobile's PCS G-block.

  - Deadlines: 50% launched by Oct 2032 and the full constellation by Oct 2035.
